annotations.title: Add a brand guide or document

description: Adds a document for Marsell to read with the business: a brand guide, a positioning doc, a price list. PDF, Word (DOCX), Markdown or text, from a public https url, its bytes, or as markdown text. It is kept whole with the setup's materials. For files on the agent's own machine, get_upload_link gives an address to send them to from your shell, so nothing big passes through your messages.

data_base64.description: Or the file's bytes, base64 (as large as one MCP message carries, about 4 MB).

filename.description: Its file name with its extension, when you have one.

markdown.description: Or the guide itself as Markdown.

url.description: A public https address of the file. Marsell fetches it itself (public addresses only, up to 8 MB).
